svg.title: W2-03 Motion Types Mini-Library (instructor)
svg.desc: Three cards from the same starting dyad C4 and E4. Oblique: one voice holds while the other moves. Contrary: the voices move in opposite directions. Similar: both voices move in the same direction.
svg.text: Motion words describe what the voices did. They are not rules about what is allowed.
Original AMF graphic, rendered from data (no AI-drawn notation). C4 = MIDI 60.
